# Mindphor

> App Store and Google Play reviews, competitor tracking, and sentiment analysis for your mobile apps.

Mindphor is a unified dashboard that tracks unlimited feedback, analyzes sentiment, and monitors competitors across the Apple App Store and Google Play Store in real time.

## Key Features
- **High-Frequency Ingestion Engine:** Instant validation and immediate course-correction on new app features based on user reviews.
- **Unified Review Dashboard:** View, filter, and search iOS and Android feedback in one place.
- **Competitor Monitoring:** Track competitor app updates and reviews to stay ahead.
- **AI Sentiment Analysis:** Automatically classifies reviews into critical, warning, or positive sentiments.
- **Smart Alerts:** Real-time webhooks and dashboard alerts when critical issues or spikes in negative feedback occur.
